mapper.select:
SELECT hj.CORP_GR AS corp_gr, hj.JM_CD AS jm_cd, hj.HJ_NM AS hj_nm, hj.CASH_CD AS cash_cd, hj.BROKER_CD AS sutak_cd, hj.PYOM_IYUL AS pyom_iyul, hj.PYOM_IYUL * 100 AS pyom_iyul_per, hj.MEIB_SUIK_RT AS meib_suik_rt, hj.BALH_YMD AS balh_ymd, hj.SANGHW_YMD AS sanghw_ymd FROM SHM0HJ hj WHERE hj.CORP_GR LIKE '%'hj.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND hj.CASH_CD = '90' AND #{workDate} BETWEEN hj.BALH_YMD AND hj.SANGHW_YMD AND hj.BROKER_CD != '%' hj.CASH_CD IN ('70', '90') AND hj.BROKER_CD IS NOT NULL AND hj.SANGHW_YMD >= ADD_MONTHS(#{workDate}, -12)
ORDER BY hj.CORP_GR, hj.CASH_CD, hj.BROKER_CD, hj.BALH_YMD DESC

SELECT F_JM_CHECK('KR9' || F_GET_ID_DAE('Y', TO_CHAR(#{balhYmd}, 'YYYY')) || F_GET_ID_DAE('M', TO_CHAR(#{balhYmd}, 'MM')) || TO_CHAR(#{balhYmd}, 'DD') || #{cashCd} || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(JM_CD, 10, 2))), 0) + 1, 2, '0')) FROM SHM0HJ WHERE CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND JM_CD LIKE 'KR9' || F_GET_ID_DAE('Y', TO_CHAR(#{balhYmd}, 'YYYY')) || F_GET_ID_DAE('M', TO_CHAR(#{balhYmd}, 'MM')) || TO_CHAR(#{balhYmd}, 'DD') || #{cashCd} || '__'

SELECT ADD_MONTHS(#{balhYmd}, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(#{sanghwYmd}, #{balhYmd}))) AS balh_ymd, F_OPEN_YMD( TO_DATE( TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(#{sanghwYmd}, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(#{sanghwYmd}, #{balhYmd}))), 'YYYYMM') || TO_CHAR(#{balhYmd}, 'DD'), 'YYYYMMDD' ), '+' ) AS sanghw_ymd FROM DUAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SHM0HJ (CORP_GR, JM_CD, HJ_NM, CASH_CD, PYOM_IYUL, BALH_YMD, SANGHW_YMD, MEIB_SUIK_RT, BROKER_CD) VALUES (#{corpGr}, #{jmCd}, #{hjNm}, #{cashCd}, #{pyomIyul}, #{balhYmd}, #{sanghwYmd}, #{meibSuikRt}, #{sutakCd})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SHM0HJ WHERE CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND JM_CD = #{jmCd}
